neet_phy_u16_t08_1.working: A line source such as a slit produces wavefronts that are cylindrical.

neet_phy_u16_t08_2.working: For a line source, intensity is proportional to 1/r. Going from 2 m to 8 m multiplies r by 4, so the intensity becomes I/4.

neet_phy_u16_t08_3.working: Speed in glass v = c/n = 3e8/1.5 = 2e8 m/s. Radius r = v t = 2e8 × 2e-9 = 0.4 m = 40 cm.

neet_phy_u16_t08_4.working: A is true: at a huge distance the spherical wavefront is effectively plane, so the rays are parallel. R is false: rays are perpendicular to the wavefront, not parallel to it.

neet_phy_u16_t08_5.working: Statement I correctly describes Huygens' construction. Statement II is correct: a spherical wave has intensity proportional to 1/r^2, giving 1/4 when r doubles; a cylindrical wave has intensity proportional to 1/r, giving 1/2.
